notes: Linux-only patch release on top of v1.4.1 (no upstream changes ported forward yet). Fixes Clawdmeter animation-mirroring, which shipped non-functional in earlier Linux releases: the desktop buddy's animation names never matched the physical Clawdmeter's current firmware catalog, so the device silently ignored them and just picked its own animations. A new translation table fixes that, and the BLE write itself switches to a more reliable mode. Verified end to end on real hardware -- the desktop buddy's actual activity (coding, thinking, waiting, idle) now correctly mirrors onto the device.
